text_block_list.text:
The day of Valentine's. The academy must 
be bustling right about now. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The snow is deep from last night's 
blizzard. Please watch your step, okay?

The forest I came to with Yamanin Zephyr 
was quiet. Our destination was a mystery, 
but I didn't have the breath to ask. 
Keeping up with her took everything I 
had...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Let's rest here in the calm. We've 
walked plenty.

There's no denying that I'm holding her 
back. If Yamanin Zephyr were on her own, 
she would surely be able to move forward 
much more freely.

Why did she invite me out today, I wonder? 
And... she doesn't seem like she's about 
to vanish into thin air, either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Such a gentle, serene time... isn't it? 
Even the sound of the swaying trees...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...However, the breath of life is strong. 
Look—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer. There are buds beneath the 
snow...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A gallant wind unyielding against the cold 
and heavy snow. Hehe... How dependable.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I sense the breath of life all around, 
beyond just this child. The wind must have 
carried them all here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Treasure the tiny seed, with utmost 
care...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...I wish to be such a blessed breeze as 
well. That is how I feel."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The reason... I can draw closer to my 
ideal gust of wind is truly thanks to your 
presence, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Through daily training, supporting me 
firmly like a great tree—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Before the match, she embraced me like the 
warm sun...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"What I have been given ranges from 
tranquil breezes to mighty gales. It is 
just like the auspicious wind I strive to 
become."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So today—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In this forest overflowing with blessings, 
I wanted to convey my gratitude to you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's what I thought, yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about words. ...I will bring 
a wind worthy of today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Though it may not yet be a blessing wind, 
I offer my gentle breeze, given shape by 
my feelings—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wanted to reach you.

Opening the box, the rich, bittersweet 
aroma of cacao wafted out. This is... 
handmade chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Did you feel the gentle summer breeze? I 
sweetened it using only cane sugar.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Also, the cacao beans were sent from 
overseas by my father. I hope you can feel 
the bounty of the earth from them...
choice_data_list: A lot of work went into this...!
A lot of work went into this, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Though it was merely a breeze, in my 
heart it was a gale. There was no room for 
it to calm."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So whether it's a refreshing breeze or a 
dark gale... Please, follow your heart's 
desire.

...Coming all the way to the forest must 
have been her own display of resolve. I 
shall gratefully accept...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A cool breeze... I see... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's small... it's a step toward 
the favorable wind. This is my... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ! Cast your eyes down...!

The strongest wind of the day blew 
furiously. Snow piled on the branches 
whipped up and battered my body...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate is covered in snow... With 
that sudden whirlwind just now, it 
couldn't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...You don't actually plan on eating that, 
do you...?

That's exactly what I mean. I've decided 
to enjoy every last bite of this 
snow-covered chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Truly a person like a refreshing 
southern breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to sit down and eat. There's a 
fallen log right here that's just right—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, don't sit just yet; turn to the east 
wind. Breath stirs at your feet.

Just as Yamanin Zephyr said, if I had sat 
down like that, I would have trampled 
right over it.
choice_data_list:
That turned out to be a blessed breeze for 
this bud.

That turned out to be a blessed breeze for 
this bud.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer... um... that whirlwind is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder where that biting 
mountain wind went.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...And yet... hehe. The flower-scented 
breeze of February is quite lovely, isn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Please enjoy your meal leisurely. Just 
like... a gentle breeze.

I savored the heartfelt chocolates one by 
one, taking my time.
